name: Jiangsu Pacific Quartz Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Pacific Quartz Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of quartz materials in China and internationally. The company offers lighting products comprising specialty lamp quartz tubes and rods, auto lamp quartz tubes and rods, and infrared lamp quartz tubes; and optical fiber quartz cylinders, vessel tubes, quartz tubes, and quartz rods.
